PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Todd Lemmis, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner

  Planning Commission In-Person Meeting

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to planningcommissioners@longbeach.gov

  Comments may also be provided in the Zoom meeting using the raise hand function or by
  pressing *9 on your phone

  Please dial: (213) 338-8477 / Meeting ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

  Please note the Zoom meeting may encounter technical disruptions, but in-person access
  and public comment will continue to be available in accordance with the Brown Act

  To view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone
  visit: https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54748  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54749  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, March 19, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54759  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-009, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15301 (Existing Facilities) and Section 15303 (New
  Construction or Conversion of Small Structures) of the CEQA Guidelines; and

  Page 1 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP24-004), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow the operation of an Interim and
  Emergency Housing facility (43-beds) for unhoused individuals and families with
  on-site management within an existing two-story building (approximately 13,500
  square feet) with nine (9) parking spaces located at 834 Pacific Avenue in the
  Downtown Plan (PD-30) Planned Development District. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54760  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-26-015, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15303 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures)
  of the CEQA Guidelines; and

  Approve a Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-015), and adopt the proposed findings
  and conditions of approval related thereto, to expand an existing liquor store
  (Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) Type 21 – Off-Sale General) to allow the addition
  of onsite tasting (ABC Type 86 - Instructional Tasting) and to reconfigure the floor
  plan to accommodate an onsite tasting area (206 square feet) within a building
  located at 4360 Stearns Street in the Community Pedestrian-Oriented (CCP)
  Zoning District. Additionally, approval of this Conditional Use Permit will result in
  the existing legal nonconforming liquor store being removed from Alcohol Nuisance
  Abatement Ordinance (ANAO) deemed approved status. (District 4)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54758  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-153, finding the
  proposed project exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Section 15303 (New Construction or Conversion of Small Structures)
  of the CEQA Guidelines; and

  Approve Conditional Use Permit (CUP25-021, TEL25-039), and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval related thereto, to allow the
  construction and operation of a new wireless telecommunications facility consisting
  of a 75-foot-tall monopole with 12 antennas, 30 remote radio units (RRUs), 1
  microwave dish, and associated ground equipment within a 480-square-foot leased
  area. The project is located at 1051 Queens Highway (APN 7436-021-907) within
  the Queensway Bay (PD-21) Planned Development District. (District 1)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54761  Recommendation to accept Compliance Checklist (PECC26-001) finding that
  project activities are within the scope of activities analyzed in the PacifiCenter @
  Long Beach EIR (Douglas Park EIR) (State Clearinghouse No. 2001051048) and

  Page 2 of 4
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 2, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  will not result in any new significant impacts, per Section 15162, 15168 (c)(2), and
  15183 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines; and

  Approve Site Plan Review (SPR26-001), Modification of an Approved Permit
  (MOD26-001), and General Plan Conformity Finding, and adopt the proposed
  findings and conditions related thereto, for the modification of a previously-
  approved Site Plan Review by adding square footage and modifying the exterior
  elevations for two industrial buildings (Buildings 20 and 21), and removing/
  replacing two previously-approved industrial buildings (Buildings 18 and 19) with a
  new four-level parking structure with approximately 2,800 parking spaces, and for
  the vacation of the portion of Conant Street adjacent to the project site located at
  3435 Conant Street in Subarea 8B of the Douglas Parking South Planned
  Development District (PD-32 South). (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54776  Recommendation to find that this action is exempt from the requirements of the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA); and

  Receive and file the 2025 General Plan Implementation Report and instruct
  Director of Community Development to submit the Implementation Report to City
  Council, State Office of Planning and Research (OPR), and Housing and
  Community Development Department (HCD). (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
